title: Excluir generaciones superseded de la presión de liveness
mission: Repair frontier-pressure owner projection so only the newest authoritative portfolio pin generation per job contributes to active/stale/replaceable liveness metrics and REPLACEABLE_PRESSURE. Historical pin generations must remain durable history but must not count as current owners. Preserve opportunity-claim behavior, terminal/dedupe closure and retry-safe recovery semantics; fail closed on ambiguous/malformed highest-generation evidence rather than silently reviving an older generation.
definition_of_done: Portfolio pin owners are collapsed to one authoritative highest generation per job before liveness counts and REPLACEABLE_PRESSURE are derived; historical generations remain inspectable evidence only.
A regression fixture with G1 stale/replaceable, G2 stale/replaceable and G3 active for one job reports exactly one ACTIVE current owner and zero REPLACEABLE current owners for that job.
The same fixture cannot trip REPLACEABLE_PRESSURE solely from superseded generations.
Opportunity-claim owners remain correctly represented and are not accidentally collapsed across distinct opportunity jobs.

Malformed or ambiguous highest-generation portfolio evidence cannot silently make an older generation authoritative or make the job newly claimable; the result fails closed with explicit evidence/test coverage.
Existing frontier-pressure compiler and dedupe/job-scoped-heartbeat tests continue to pass.
node --test tests/frontier-pressure-compiler-v1.test.mjs and any dedicated new regression test pass.
node scripts/check-efficiency-ratchet.mjs . (or the repository's equivalent ratchet invocation) passes with EFF004 preserved.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w promotion occurs.
